instruction:
I want to enable global hotkeys for VLC so I can control playback even when VLC is not the active window. Please enable the global play/pause hotkey.
How do I configure this setting?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC's global play/pause hotkey (global-key-play-pause set to non-empty value). Uses existing check_global_key_play_pause metric function. Expected value is 1 (enabled).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly extracts VLC configuration file from appropriate OS-specific path
Metric (check_global_key_play_pause) correctly checks if global-key-play-pause is enabled: empty value = disabled (0), non-empty value = enabled (1)
Expected value (1) semantically correct for 'enable global play/pause hotkey' requirement
Postconfig properly kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config file is written to disk
Complete coverage: instruction requires enabling global hotkey, evaluator verifies this exact setting
Proper parameter handling: directly accesses rule dict without incorrect patterns
Edge cases handled: file not found, exceptions, missing config keys
